summary.zh: 构建带状态管理和路由的多组件网页
summary.en: Build multi-component web pages with React, Tailwind and shadcn/ui.

description.zh: 面向需要状态管理、路由或 shadcn/ui 组件的复杂页面，按组件拆分生成可运行的网页成果。适合做交互原型、内部工具界面这类有层级和状态的页面，不适合单文件小页面。需要 Node 环境并安装依赖。
description.en: Builds complex pages that need state management, routing or shadcn/ui components as runnable multi-file artifacts. Suits interactive prototypes and internal tools rather than single-file snippets. Requires Node and installed dependencies.
